title: CrestApps Attachments configuration
description: The settings of the Attachments module read from appsettings.json, in the OrchardCore section of the host or a tenant.

Attachments.description: The upload policy of record attachments.

MaxFileBytes.description: The largest file accepted, in bytes.

MaxFilesPerUpload.description: How many files one upload may carry.

AllowedFormats.description: The formats accepted; empty accepts every format the site knows.

AzureBlob.description: Keeps the files in an Azure Blob Storage container instead of the tenant's application data.

ContainerName.description: The container; Liquid such as {{ ShellSettings.Name }} is allowed.

BasePath.description: The folder inside the container; Liquid is allowed.

CreateContainer.description: Whether the container is created when the tenant starts.
